title: Staring at One Another
text: When Jacob learned that there was grain in Egypt, he said to his sons, “Why are you staring at one another?”

title: Afraid for Benjamin
text: But Jacob did not send Joseph’s brother Benjamin with his brothers, for he said, “I am afraid that harm might befall him.”

title: They Bowed Down
text: … they bowed down before him with their faces to the ground.

title: You Are Spies!
text: Joseph remembered his dreams about them and said, “You are spies!

title: How You Will Be Tested
text: And this is how you will be tested …

title: We Saw His Anguish
text: We saw his anguish when he pleaded with us, but we would not listen.

title: Joseph Wept
text: And he turned away from them and wept.

title: Silver in the Sacks
text: Then Joseph gave orders to fill their bags with grain, to return each man’s silver to his sack …

title: What Is This That God Has Done?
text: What is this that God has done to us?

title: Simeon Is No More
text: Joseph is gone and Simeon is no more. Now you want to take Benjamin.

title: I Will Guarantee His Safety
text: I will guarantee his safety. You may hold me personally responsible.

title: If I Am Bereaved
text: As for me, if I am bereaved, I am bereaved.

title: Five Times Larger
text: … Benjamin’s portion was five times larger than any of the others.

title: May God Be Gracious
text: May God be gracious to you, my son.

title: The Silver Cup
text: Put my cup, the silver one, in the mouth of the youngest one’s sack …

title: Good with Evil
text: Why have you repaid good with evil?

title: The Cup Was Found
text: … and the cup was found in Benjamin’s sack.

title: They Tore Their Clothes
text: Then they all tore their clothes, loaded their donkeys, and returned to the city.

title: I Will Bear the Guilt
text: If I do not return him to you, I will bear the guilt before you, my father, all my life.

title: Judah's Offer
text: Now please let your servant stay here as my lord’s slave in place of the boy. Let him return with his brothers.

title: An Interpreter
text: They did not realize that Joseph understood them, since there was an interpreter between them.

title: Eating Apart
text: They ate separately because the Egyptians would not eat with the Hebrews, since that was detestable to them.
